Calculate your supply

About PureLine Hygiene

What does PureLine Hygiene do?

We manufacture and supply sanitary pads in South Africa for tender winners, organisations preparing tender submissions, institutions, retailers and procurement teams.

How do I contact you?

Email PureLine Hygiene. If you have already sent an enquiry, include your reference number (for example PLH-8F3A92C7).

Pricing and estimates

Is the estimate a quotation?

No. The estimate is indicative and final pricing is subject to confirmation. You receive a formal quotation after our team reviews your enquiry.

Why is the price per pad the same for very large quantities?

Every customer big or small gets the same price. We are committed to “equal opportunity for all”.

Can I enter a price lower than your starting price?

Yes. Tell us the price you want to pay. If it is below our current price, we confirm what is possible in your quotation.

Do stickers, decals or delivery change the estimate?

Yes. Stickers are an additional cost that depends on the level of customisation you require. Delivery cost depends on your quantity and your distance from our depot. Both are confirmed in your quotation.

Enquiries and quote requests

What is a quote request?

A quote request tells our team what you need so we can review it and prepare a quotation. It is not a confirmed order.

Can I change my requirements after saving?

Yes. Until you submit, select "Edit requirements" or adjust the estimator and your saved draft is updated automatically. Or contact us using your reference number and we will do our best to accommodate you.

What happens after I submit?

Our team reviews your requirements and contacts you using the details you provided. If we need more information, such as technical or procurement details, we will ask for it.

Tenders and procurement

I have won a tender. What should I prepare?

Have your tender reference number, product specification, required standards, packaging specification, delivery address and required delivery date ready. We will only ask for what is relevant to your order.

I am preparing a tender submission. Can you help?

Yes. Choose "Preparing a tender" at the top of the home page and submit your enquiry. Our team will discuss your requirements and the quotation you need for your submission.

Can you supply against a specific standard, such as a SANS standard?

Tell us the standard your tender specifies. We confirm compliance with applicable standards, and the documentation we can provide, in your quotation.

Can you provide B-BBEE and compliance documents?

Let us know which documents your procurement process requires when we follow up, and we will confirm what can be provided with your quotation.

Orders

Is there a minimum order quantity?

The estimator accepts any quantity up to 1,000,000 pads. Any minimum order quantity for your product and packaging is confirmed in your quotation. We can supply more, and the price per pack will stay the same.

When is my order confirmed?

We will sign a supply agreement with you, then your requirements will be met. Estimates and quote requests are not orders.

Privacy and your information

What information do you collect?

Your supply requirements (including your delivery point, if you give one), and the contact details you enter: name, company or organisation (optional), town or city, email address and contact number (optional). We do not ask for your date of birth or ID number, and you do not need an account.

Why do you need it?

Only to review your enquiry, contact you about it and prepare your quotation. We do not use these details for marketing without your consent, and we do not share your details in any form with any other entity or person.

Will you contact me on WhatsApp?

Only if you provided a contact number and ticked the WhatsApp option when submitting your enquiry.

How long do you keep my information?

Drafts that are never submitted are deleted automatically after 30 days. Submitted enquiries are kept only for as long as needed to respond to your enquiry.

How is my information protected?

Enquiries are stored in a private Google Sheet that only our team can open, hosted by Google in its data centres, which may be outside South Africa. Google applies protection comparable to POPIA. Your browser only holds a temporary key for your own draft, which is cleared when you submit.

Can I see, correct or delete my information?

Yes. Email PureLine Hygiene with your reference number and tell us what you would like to access, correct or delete, and we will action your request.
